# Contents
::: {.lead}
Every tutorial in the course, topic by topic. Within a topic the tutorials
are listed alphabetically.
:::

[← Back to Course 1 — Foundations of Game Theory](index.qmd)

## Topic 1 · Foundations {#foundations}

Equilibrium concepts, information, repeated games, complexity — the formal core. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/foundations/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-foundations .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 2 · Classical Games {#classical-games}

Prisoner's Dilemma, Hawk-Dove, oligopoly, bargaining, coordination — the canon. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/classical-games/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-classical-games .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 3 · Decision Theory {#decision-theory}

Expected utility, prospect theory, ambiguity, sequential and group decision. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/decision-theory/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-decision-theory .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 4 · Evolutionary Game Theory {#evolutionary-gt}

Replicator dynamics, ESS, Moran processes, spatial games, co-evolution. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/evolutionary-gt/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-evolutionary-gt .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 5 · Cooperative Game Theory {#cooperative-gt}

Shapley value, core, nucleolus, coalition formation, cost allocation. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/cooperative-gt/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-cooperative-gt .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 6 · Behavioral Game Theory {#behavioral-gt}

Bounded rationality, QRE, level-k, social preferences, learning. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/behavioral-gt/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-behavioral-gt .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 7 · Network Games {#network-games}

Strategic network formation, diffusion, influence, centrality as power. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/network-games/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-network-games .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 8 · History of Game Theory {#history-of-gt-mathematics}

From Cournot 1838 through von Neumann, Nash, Selten, to modern Nobel laureates. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/history-of-gt-mathematics/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-history-of-gt-mathematics .course-contents}
:::
